arStrings.szText: It started with whalesong. The crew said it sang to them. Never mind that these waters are too shallow for whales.
They say the coin washing up on these shores is a gift from the singer. Never mind that we're surrounded by shipwrecks.
They call it the Fathomless One. They say it asks terrible things of them. Flesh. Never mind we were friends, once.
I pretend along with them now. I already gave up an ear. How much more will they demand?
